title: Native Son
author: Richard Wright
summary: A young Black man in 1930s Chicago takes a job as a chauffeur for a wealthy white family. One night's accident sets off events that ruin his life and lay bare the forces that boxed him in.
readIf: you want a hard-hitting classic that explains, rather than excuses, how pressure and fear can shape a person.
skipIf: you want hope or a sympathetic hero; the violence and its subject can be very harsh.

pairings.reason: Another landmark novel of Black American life, more experimental and bitterly comic.
A modern young adult novel about race and violence, easier to read but still deeply felt.
The gentler, more hopeful side of the same questions about justice, told through a white child's eyes.
